response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack engineer (14+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js expertise, direct experience in AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at his current role, and a broad polyglot background covering nearly all required and secondary technologies. He lacks explicit React/Nest.js/Vitest mentions and Kotlin experience, but his depth, adaptability, and craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, testing tools he's built himself) strongly compensate.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience (14+ years) across web, backend, and infrastructure
Direct current experience with AI-agent tooling and MCP frameworks, a required skill
Strong testing/quality culture — built own testing frameworks (Trial, Fluent-Asserts), practiced TDD/CI/CD
concerns: No explicit mention of React or Nest.js, core primary stack technologies
No Kotlin experience listed, only Java, C#, and DLang for backend variety
Frequent job changes (~10 roles in 14 years) could signal short tenure risk

key_factors.factor: Deep seniority and polyglot engineering breadth
